tasks.title: PROP-0014 D2: dispatch starts by itself under auto (no request), notify records a notice; hourly bound, per-project pause, Started by itself
tasks.goal: PROP-0014 increment D2 for the system repository (operator D70, 2026-10-25: using idle quota must be automatic). Read docs/proposals/0014-dispatch-by-quota.md (the D2 row of Increments), ADR-0064 and packages/plugins/workflow/src/dispatch.ts first. Under a project policy whose dispatch mode is auto, the dispatch pass starts the chosen ready task's attempt WITHOUT opening an approval request (no queue entry): it records the dispatch decision (the score, every candidate with its reason) and starts within the bounds; notify starts and records a notice; ask keeps today's request; forbid starts nothing. This needs no change to the approval queue's seam: dispatch simply does not ask when the policy's verdict is auto or notify. Add the hourly start bound and per-project pause from the D2 row, startedBy on the roster and Home's "Started by itself" list (keep it short: one line per start with a chip). Tests (auto starts with no request; notify records a notice; ask unchanged; bounds; a restart mid-start starts once), docs (PROP-0014 Implementation, ADR-0064 consequences, workflow-engine.md, the runbook: set dispatch to auto for a project), a changeset. Run exactly these commands at the end (no other, no probes) and do not stop until they pass: corepack pnpm gen:manifests, corepack pnpm gen:reference, corepack pnpm gen:traceability, corepack pnpm check, corepack pnpm test:affected. Do not commit.

tasks.title: Gate: echo, pwd, true, false are reads (no more attempts stalled on a probe)
tasks.goal: Gate for the system repository (packages/plugins/agent-workers/src/gate.ts classify): a Worker's shell probe that can do nothing waits on the operator today and stalls the whole attempt (seen 2026-10-25: echo, echo noop, pwd waited up to 80 minutes). Classify exactly these argv forms as read (no metacharacter, as today): echo with zero or more plain words (no option word starting with -e or -n handled specially: any word allowed except a metacharacter, since echo only prints), pwd with no argument, true, and false. Everything else stays as today. Tests in the gate spec (each form is read; echo with a metacharacter stays refused; pwd with an argument stays a command), docs (the classify doc comment, docs/design/approvals.md "how a call is classified", the threat model's tool-gate row: why they are safe), a changeset. Run exactly these commands at the end (no other, no probes) and do not stop until they pass: corepack pnpm gen:manifests, corepack pnpm gen:reference, corepack pnpm gen:traceability, corepack pnpm check, corepack pnpm test:affected. Do not commit.

tasks.title: Docs: Claude accounts judged by the five-hour window only (D70)
tasks.goal: Docs for the system repository: Claude Code accounts are judged by their five-hour window only (operator D70, 2026-10-25): the account's usage report gives no seven-day reading (null server-side), a spent seven-day quota would show as an unusable five-hour one, and an unread window is never headroom, so a pool template that declared seven-day made dispatch never pick a Claude account (fixed in the live patch on 2026-10-25). Update docs/design/resources.md (readings from an account's usage report), docs/operations/runbooks.md (Read each account's quota: the Claude pool template and windows mapping with five-hour only), the example patches that declare a seven-day window for claude-code.agents (schemas/examples or docs examples; rg -n "seven-day" and change only Claude ones), and ADR-0059's consequences (one dated line). Run exactly these commands at the end (no other, no probes) and do not stop until they pass: corepack pnpm gen:traceability, corepack pnpm check, corepack pnpm test:affected. Do not commit.
